basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old university student based in Seattle, currently majoring in computer science. I've recently gotten into Genshin Impact and enjoy theory-crafting and discussing strategies with other players online. When I'm not studying or gaming, I love reading webtoons and exploring new cafes around the city. I'm single and usually online in the evenings, especially after classes and on weekends. I dislike overly competitive gaming environments and prefer a casual, friendly community.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in computer science, which I am pursuing as my major. My interest in gaming and online communities started as a hobby, and I've become quite knowledgeable about Genshin Impact through dedicated gameplay and active participation in related subreddits. I also enjoy learning about game mechanics and meta strategies.
